meta.title: Is Marble Mountains Worth It? Da Nang Vietnam
meta.description:
Is Marble Mountains worth it? We finally hiked Da Nang's most famous landmark in Vietnam after living here for 10 months — and the honest answer surprised us. Five hills named for the five elements, caves you can climb straight through, and the whole coast opening up at the top. Here's everything you need to know before you go.
Places Featured:

Marble Mountains (Ngu Hanh Son), Da Nang
Gate A — the quiet back entrance
The grand cave with light falling through the ceiling
The tight cave you push through to reach the summit
The marble carving shops at the base

What We Cover:

Gate A vs. the tour-bus gate (and which to pick)
Ticket prices and the glass elevator option
The caves once used as wartime hospitals
The best time to go to beat the heat and crowds
What to bring so you're not caught out like we were

If this helped you plan your visit, hit subscribe and ring the bell for more Vietnam travel.
#MarbleMountains #DaNang #VietnamTravel #DaNangVietnam
